messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — proposal for a phased private-offer we can push on Cloud Marketplaces + HW partner bundle. Goals: predictable commit for Redwood, minimal churn for partner, co-announcement aligned with SI enablement.
Tom: High level ok. What's the phase model?
Aisha: Phase 1 (0–90 days) — trial tranche with 30% discount, convertible to annual committed SKU. Phase 2 (90–270 days) — convert to reserved capacity with step-up discount. Include an escape hatch if SI integration not completed by 120 days.
Priya: We need clear proration and commit credit rules. Partner asks for pro-rata refund window. Recommend: credits applied toward next term at 70% of remaining value, not refunds.
Luca: Can we map to marketplace SKUs? Need sample mapping for partner legal: bundle-hw-1 -> sku.redwood.dedicated.5g
Megan: I'll own SI enablement checklist. Tasks: docs, runbook, joint testplan, demo script. ETA 2 weeks.
Aisha: Add embargoed joint announcement date — target Nov 15 internal, public Nov 22. That gives SI 2 weeks post-contract to finish enablement.
Tom: Risks: reseller margin + marketplace fees eat into partner economics. Suggest we guarantee a minimum commit conversion bonus if partner meets 6-month adoption metrics.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: marketplace private-offer flow requires 7 business days for approval. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/marketplace-private-offers
Priya: Sample billing mapping (share with partner legal):
```
bundle-hw-std: {
  marketplace_sku: "sku.redwood.dedicated.4g",
  commit_credit: "monthly_prorated",
  discount: "30%_intro -> 20%_post-conversion"
}
```
Luca: For SI co-sell, propose quarterly renewal checkpoints (30/90/180 days) to avoid surprises.
Megan: I'll draft the joint announcement timeline and circulate Monday.
Aisha: Thanks — action items: Megan (announce timeline), Megan+Priya (billing mapping final), Luca (SI checkpoints), Tom (partner economics note). Ping me on this thread with any blockers. :thumbsup:
